parent.title: A Dreis weekend, anchored on dinner at Waldhotel Sonnora

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Waldhotel Sonnora
siblings.summary: Mosel villages, Eifel Maare, castles, Riesling cellars and one via ferrata, all inside 30 km of Dreis.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Waldhotel Sonnora
siblings.summary: Trier hosts CiE 2026 in late July, the WRO German final in June, plus a few smaller AI/digital workshops.

sources.title: hotel-sonnora.de
sources.claim: Waldhotel Sonnora has 20 individually designed rooms; gourmet breakfast included; near Dreis with Wittlich and Bernkastel-Kues as nearest towns.

sources.title: Forest Suite — hotel-sonnora.de
sources.claim: Forest Suite ~90 m², sauna, private terrace, €595/night.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Waldhotel Sonnora
sources.claim: Three Michelin stars in Dreis.

sources.title: travelsforstars.com — Waldhotel Sonnora
sources.claim: Most remote of Germany's ten 3★ tables; set in woodland near tiny Dreis.

sources.title: Marriott — Schloss Lieser, Autograph Collection
sources.claim: Fully restored 19th-c castle on Moselle, vineyards, Autograph Collection.

sources.title: schlosslieser.de — rooms & suites
sources.claim: 4 suites (incl. 125 m² Kaisersuite), 4 junior suites, 7 apartments, 34 doubles, 1 single.

sources.title: bellevue-hotel.de
sources.claim: Romantik Jugendstilhotel Bellevue 1903; 4★S Art-Nouveau on Moselle; spa, pool, sauna.

sources.title: mosel-inside.de — Bellevue history
sources.claim: Many Art Nouveau buildings in Traben-Trarbach built by Bruno Möhring; Bellevue hosted Richthofen, Anhalt, Thyssen, Rühmann.

sources.title: bellevue-hotel.de — standard double
sources.claim: Standard double €164/night double-occ., breakfast & spa included.

sources.title: weinromantikhotel.com
sources.claim: Stylish 4★S in Mülheim winery estate, gardens, spa, restaurant.

sources.title: romantikhotels.com — Richtershof
sources.claim: Member of Romantik Hotels group; Mülheim vineyard estate.

sources.title: molitors-muehle.de
sources.claim: Former mill in Salmtal valley, five lakes, 700 m² spa, lakeside log-cabin sauna.

sources.title: maerchenhotel.com — fairy-tale hotel
sources.claim: Each room themed after a different fairy tale; family-run; 5-min walk from Mosel.

sources.title: maerchenhotel.com
sources.claim: Märchenhotel markets itself as fairy-tale themed hotel on the Mosel.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Praise for architecture & ambiance; some standard rooms dark with no outside view.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Waldhotel Sonnora
sources.claim: #1 of 1 in Dreis, 4/5; renovated 2020–21; breakfast integral to experience.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Bellevue
sources.claim: Often cited as Germany's most beautiful Art Nouveau hotel; multi-award Belle Epoque restaurant.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Märchenhotel
sources.claim: 'A real fairytale, beautifully decorated' vs 'rooms felt darker than photos portray'.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Molitors Mühle
sources.claim: 9.2 location, 9.3 couples, 8.0 value; one reviewer accuses over-monetisation.

sources.title: Kayak — Märchenhotel
sources.claim: Nightly rates from ~$134, averages near $179.

sources.title: Kayak — Richtershof
sources.claim: Rates from ~$150; averages $184–$232.

sources.title: Expedia — Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Typical ~$258/night, deals from $176.

sources.title: Luxury Lifestyle Mag — Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Luxury castle hotel with opulent rooms, restored period interiors, Moselle-facing setting.

sources.title: VisitMosel — Richtershof
sources.claim: Listed among region's signature accommodations on the wine route.

sources.title: Eifel tourist board — Waldhotel Sonnora
sources.claim: Regional flagship culinary destination in Eifel/Mosel transition.
